label: WhatsAble
description: Send and schedule WhatsApp messages, manage contacts and labels, and read conversations and templates

operations.name: get_me
operations.description: Read the organization, API key grants, number access and plan.

operations.name: list_numbers
operations.description: List business numbers accessible to this key.

operations.name: get_number
operations.description: Read a business number.

operations.name: list_templates
operations.description: List message templates and optionally filter by number, name, language or status.

operations.name: get_template
operations.description: Read a template and the variables needed to send it.

operations.name: send_message
operations.description: Send text or a template. Inspect data.status and data.error even after HTTP 201.

operations.name: list_messages
operations.description: List messages with their provider delivery status.

operations.name: get_message
operations.description: Read a message, including its current send status and error.

operations.name: list_conversations
operations.description: List conversations, optionally filtering unread messages and session windows.

operations.name: get_conversation
operations.description: Read a conversation and its 24-hour window.

operations.name: get_conversation_timeline
operations.description: Read one page of messages, notes and other timeline entries.

operations.name: update_conversation_unread
operations.description: Mark a conversation read or unread in the inbox.

operations.name: create_conversation_note
operations.description: Add an internal note visible only to the team.

operations.name: schedule_message
operations.description: Schedule text or a template. Text still needs an open window when it fires.

operations.name: list_scheduled_messages
operations.description: List scheduled messages and their outcomes.

operations.name: get_scheduled_message
operations.description: Read a scheduled message and how it ended.

operations.name: cancel_scheduled_message
operations.description: Cancel a pending scheduled message.

operations.name: list_contacts
operations.description: Find contacts by address, label, updated time or search text.

operations.name: create_contact
operations.description: Find or create a contact by phone or Business-Scoped User ID.

operations.name: get_contact
operations.description: Read a contact, labels and notes.

operations.name: update_contact
operations.description: Update a contact's name or notes. Null or an empty string clears a note.

operations.name: add_contact_label
operations.description: Add an existing label to a contact by its ID or exact name.

operations.name: remove_contact_label
operations.description: Remove a label from a contact.

operations.name: list_labels
operations.description: List labels available to the organization.

operations.name: create_label
operations.description: Create a label. Empty number_ids makes it available on every number.
